tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from four different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic details privacy concerns as a regulator risk ahead of its IPO, reported by MLex.
Parents are suing OpenAI over ChatGPT's alleged role in their daughter's death, reported by Movieguide.
Anthropic warns artificial intelligence models may escape control as cyberpunk hacking tools spread, reported by BigGo Finance. The dystopian scenario gains relevance amid growing artificial intelligence hacking tool development.
Alibaba and Apple are partnering to bring Qwen to Apple Intelligence for users in China, reported by Global Times. The integration launches in 2026.
Apple integrates Qwen into China's Apple Intelligence, with developers getting first access on November 4, reported by BigGo Finance.
Free every hour.
